column3: Close to the Hebrew; יִדְלַק (“hotly pursues”) is rendered “persecutes.”
NKJV takes “the greedy” as the object of “blesses,” giving “He blesses the greedy and renounces the LORD.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the height of his nose” is rendered “his proud countenance,” and NKJV supplies “God” as object.
Close to the Hebrew; יָחִילוּ (“are firm”) is rendered “are always prospering,” and “he breathes out at them” “he sneers at them.”
The verse is difficult; NKJV renders “So he crouches, he lies low, That the helpless may fall by his strength.”
Close to the Hebrew; “you will not seek” is rendered “You will not require an account.”
Close to the Hebrew; יַעֲזֹב (“leaves [himself]”) is rendered “commits himself to You.”
Close to the Hebrew; “you will seek his wickedness; you will not find” is rendered “Seek out his wickedness until You find none.”
Close to the Hebrew; תָּכִין (“you strengthen”) is rendered “You will prepare.”
